sessions.sourceDescriptionRaw: | Performances: June 23-27 | Children's Musical Theater San Jose (CMT San Jose) presents Disney's Dare to Dream JR., a musical revue that follows an eager group of trainees on their first day at a fictional Walt Disney Imagineering Studio. As the trainees work together to discover their own dreams, they uncover the power that imagination and teamwork have to make anything possible. Celebrating 100 years of Disney music, the production features 20 songs spanning a century of beloved films, including selections making their stage debut alongside favorites from The Princess and the Frog, Coco, Encanto, and Frozen II. Now in its 59th season, CMT San Jose is one of the region's premier youth performing arts organizations, offering training and performance opportunities to thousands of young artists each year. CMT San Jose trains and educates today's youth through musical theater to set and achieve high artistic and personal goals, and to inspire them to become exemplary artists, patrons and citizens of tomorrow. The organization is dedicated to fostering creativity and a lifelong love of the performing arts in a supportive and inclusive environment.
